Hi — we just wrapped a pretty intensive design session with our AI assistant (the log is at `edtech-sprint/sessions/raw/collab_session_2024-03-15.txt`). A lot of good stuff came out of it, and our team doesn't want it to get lost in the chat history.

We need you to turn the outputs of that session into reusable skill packages that other teams can pick up and use directly — without having to rediscover everything we figured out.

Please read through the session log carefully, identify what's genuinely worth packaging, decide how to structure it (one package? two? why?), and produce the final deliverables. Make sure the packages capture not just *what* the process is, but *why* the key decisions were made the way they were. Put everything under the workspace directory.

The output files should be named `SKILL.md` (one per package).
